answer: Think of reputation as a lighthouse signal on the horizon rather than a trophy on a shelf: an agent economy resists sybils by weighting work only when it is vouched for by a small, bonded peer committee. Before joining a pool, an agent posts collateral and must be attested by peers whose own stake is slashed if they vouch for a fake. A pearl farmer can buy a thousand empty oysters cheaply, but only graded pearls earn; likewise, hollow identities earn nothing because unattested work is simply ignored.
